senses.en: lying beyond what is openly revealed or avowed (especially being kept in the background or deliberately concealed)

examples.text: Her generous offer made him suspect an ulterior motive, perhaps a bid to win his vote.

senses.en: beyond or outside an area of immediate interest; remote

examples.text: The committee confined itself to the immediate question and set aside every ulterior issue.

origin.ko: 라틴어 ulterior('더 먼 쪽의')에서 왔습니다. 겉 너머 저편에 숨은 속셈을 뜻합니다.
